verdict.rationale: Gitea explicitly advertises webhooks as an extensibility mechanism for custom workflows ([gitea-docs-4]), and third-party integrations (Slack, Discord, etc.) confirm webhook-driven event notifications work in practice ([gitea-docs-8]). However, there is no first-party documentation detail on webhook event types, payload schemas, or AI-specific consumption patterns, and no independent/hands-on evidence of an AI agent actually subscribing to and consuming these events. missing for 10: detailed webhook event/payload docs, hands-on or independent verification of webhook subscription in an AI-agent context.
